mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.PERMISSION_CODE FROM user_permissions up INNER JOIN permissions p ON up.PERMISSION_ID = p.permission_id_str WHERE up.USER_ID::bigint = #{userId} AND up.DELETED = 0 AND p.DELETED = 0 AND p.STATUS = 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.PERMISSION_CODE FROM user_roles ur INNER JOIN roles r ON ur.ROLE_ID = r.role_id_str INNER JOIN role_permissions rp ON r.role_id_str = rp.ROLE_ID INNER JOIN permissions p ON rp.PERMISSION_ID = p.permission_id_str WHERE ur.USER_ID::bigint = #{userId} AND ur.DELETED = 0 AND r.DELETED = 0 AND rp.DELETED = 0 AND p.DELETED = 0 AND p.STATUS = 1
